title: Chromascope: an open-source, AI-ready LC-MS workbench
description: Chromascope is a free, open-source application for AI-assisted LC-MS analysis, across instrument vendors, with traceable results. It reads mzML directly and vendor files through ProteoWizard MSConvert, integrates peaks, builds calibration curves and runs quantification and QC, as a desktop app, a JSON command-line tool, or over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI assistants.
